segments.text:
Touching the Propheſie of Chriſt, it is that whereby he hath perfectly revealed the whole will of God out of the boſome of the Father, that is needfull for his ſervants
to know, beleeve, and obey; and therefore is called not onely a Prophet and a Doctor, and the Apoſtle of our profeſſion, and the Angel of the Covenant; but alſo the very wiſdome of God, and the treaſures of wiſdome and underſtanding.
